WITH budget_event_join AS (
  SELECT 
    b.spent,
    b.amount,
    e.type as event_type
  FROM budget b
  JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
event_type_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    event_type,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount != 0 
        THEN CAST(spent AS FLOAT) / CAST(amount AS FLOAT)
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) as avg_ratio
  FROM budget_event_join
  GROUP BY event_type
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg
  FROM event_type_averages
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  eta.event_type,
  eta.avg_ratio,
  eta.avg_ratio - oa.overall_avg as difference
FROM event_type_averages eta
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE eta.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY eta.event_type
